description: Generic synthetic two-wave brand-survey fixture (lavaan-parity oracle data). Three correlated standard-normal factors; each rating is round(intercept + loading*factor + N(0, noise_sd)) clamped to [min, max]; recommend is round(intercept + sum(weight*factor) + N(0, noise_sd)) clamped. Rows 0..n/2-1 are wave 1, the rest wave 2, whose factor means shift by wave2_shift. Generated by brandSurvey (internal/sem/brand_fixture_test.go) from this spec and seed; TestSEM_BrandSurveyRegenerates holds brand_data.csv to it byte for byte (regenerate: go test ./internal/sem -run TestSEM_BrandSurveyRegenerates -regen-brand).
